audit.why: FAV / 4/10 matches 53.41% over 264 games and the mirror (sejuani__gnar) kept the Gnar-favoured early chart. Early bully, Rage-gated mid, her scaling teamfight late is the right shape.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two-item row named Gnar while whys[6], spikes[3] and the late block all say Sejuani becomes an unkillable frontline; the packet chart reads Skill there.
audit.why: Restating the mirror from this side: her power is item- and teamfight-gated, so the 2+ item row belongs to neither duellist outright. Real numbers added elsewhere: Arctic Assault 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Glacial Prison 120/105/90s, Gnar's Hop 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: win[6] and phases[6].side set to Skill with phases[6].why rewritten to state why the duel closes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) The page tells you to track 'Permafrost's cooldown' — Permafrost (E) is a 1.5-second ability; it is not cooldown-gated at all, it is gated on the target having maximum Frost stacks, which come from Winter's Wrath (W, 9/8/7/6/5s). (b) Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, which is never mentioned anywhere, even though Boomerang's slow and Mega Boulder Toss are Gnar's whole kiting engine.
audit.why: Both invert the advice. Counting a 1.5s timer is useless; counting her W hits is the actual skill. And a Gnar who expects his Boomerang slow to hold an out-of-combat Sejuani walks into an Arctic Assault knockup at full speed.
audit.corrected: Permafrost is 1.5s and fires only at max Frost stacks — break off after her second Winter's Wrath swing. Frost Armor makes her slow-immune until it is broken by damage, so Boomerang only kites her once she is already in combat. Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1, 650 range) is her single gap-closer; Hop is 22s at rank 1, so it is not a free answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frost Armor's slow immunity was absent from every field.
audit.why: It is the hidden mechanic that decides whether Gnar's disengage works on her first approach.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[2] and the early block.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Sejuani carry threat 5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in she is a Frost-Armored frontline you cannot solo-burst — your wall-pin GNAR! still wins fights, the 1v1 does not.

edits.before: You keep kiting with Q slow and Hyper move speed; once her Arctic Assault dash is spent she can't reach you to stack Frost for the Permafrost stun.
edits.after: Kite on Hyper move speed — Frost Armor makes her slow-immune, so your Boomerang slow only bites after her armor breaks; her Q dash is 18s.

edits.before: Sejuani's only gap-closer is Arctic Assault (Q), a single dash with a long early cooldown, and she has no ranged poke — so Mini Gnar just bullies her. Auto, throw Boomerang for the slow, and catch it on the return for the cooldown refund. Lead with the Hyper third-hit at level 2 for a chunky free trade, then walk away on the move-speed burst before she can stack Frost. The thing to respect is her Permafrost: don't let her chain enough ability hits to detonate the stun, and don't sit still long enough for a baited Arctic Assault to connect.
edits.after: Sejuani's only gap-closer is Arctic Assault (Q), one dash on 18 seconds at rank 1, and she has no ranged poke — so Mini Gnar bullies her. Auto, throw Boomerang, and catch it on the return for the cooldown refund; note Frost Armor makes her slow-immune, so the slow only bites once damage has broken it. Lead with the Hyper third-hit at level 2, then leave on the move-speed burst. Permafrost has no real cooldown at 1.5 seconds — the gate is Frost stacks, so break off after her second Winter's Wrath (W) swing.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost is 1.5s — the gate is Frost stacks from W, so break off after her second W swing.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — 1.5s cooldown, gated on max Frost stacks, so count her W swings, not a timer. Arctic Assault is 18s at rank 1. - Your Hop: 22s at rank 1, never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Sidestep or bait her Arctic Assault (Q) dash, then kite out on Hyper move speed while it's on cooldown
edits.after: Bait Arctic Assault (Q) and kite out on Hyper move speed for the 18 seconds it stays down at rank 1
